verdicts.reason: The repo does gate F-2-T as [{edu:4,rank:3},{experience:5}], so a reader with no degree and 5 years' experience sees it OPEN. In the advanced-industry track, education and career are cumulative, and career-only needs 8 years, so that gate is too loose. The proposed fix is too strict. It drops the 4x-GNI relaxation that its own evidence cites (education OR career alone is enough), and it ignores the MSIT science track in force since June 2026 (any ONE of awards, papers, commercialisation or career). Because it sits on the visa, it would also apply to every in-Korea edge (E-7-T, F-2-7, E-1, E-3, E-7-1, D-10-T). The gate should be the union of what can actually qualify.
verdicts.correctedFix:
data/visamap.yaml, visas: F-2-T: replace
    needs:
    - {edu: 4, rank: 3}
    - {experience: 5}
with
    needs:
    - {edu: 4, rank: 3}          # top-100 master's+ (enough alone only with income >= 4x GNI)
    - {experience: 8}            # 8+ years career incl. 3 at a global firm (alone only with >= 4x GNI)
    - {edu: 5, experience: 5}    # doctorate + 5 years' research (research track / MSIT track)
and set how.en to: 'World-class high-tech or science talent with a ministry recommendation and income of 3× GNI or more: a master''s or doctorate from a world top-100 university AND either 8+ years of work (3 of them at a global top company) or 5+ years of research after a doctorate (3 at a top institute); income of 4× GNI waives one of the two. Since June 2026, science professors and researchers recommended by the Ministry of Science and ICT can also qualify through major awards, top-cited papers, key patents or a senior research post.' The ru, uz and uz-cyrl strings must be translated to match.

verdicts.reason: F-5-11 has no needs, age or countries, so every reader sees NONE -> F-5-11 OPEN. The real test is achievement-based: 30+ points on mandatory items such as world-renowned figure, Nobel-class prize, world-class research or IP, and 50+ in total. A degree is only an optional item, so gating on edu would block athletes and artists who qualify. The proposed gate is also technically broken: the experience select tops out at 8 ('8+ years'), so experience: 10 can never be met by an answered value. None of the engine's facts is a legal precondition, so the honest fix is a clearer requirement text, not a blocking gate.

The ru, uz and uz-cyrl strings must be translated to match.

verdicts.reason: The claim holds. The D-8 가목 status is defined by being essential staff of a foreign-invested company, and the KRW 100M is the company's foreign investment, not a personal requirement. Invest KOREA defines essential staff as executives, senior managers and specialist technicians, including staff sent by the foreign parent. The repo's needs {invest: 1} therefore blocks such staff when they answer 'None'. The fix's alternatives are invented: no rule lets a plain bachelor's degree qualify, and a position-based criterion is better approximated by experience alone.

verdicts.reason: F-3's how says 'D, E or F-2 status holder'. The decree covers only D-1 to E-7 and excludes D-3 by name, so families of E-8, E-9 and E-10 holders are not covered. The KIS visa manual also adds F-2, F-4 and H-2 families, which matches the repo's own visadocs F-3 abroad case. The engine cannot tell the sponsor's status apart (spouse: foreigner), so correcting the how text is the right level of fix.

verdicts.reason: F-2 가목 grants F-2 to the minor child of an F-5 holder, and the repo's F-2-3 change and extend lists both carry that case. The NONE edge's override {spouse: f5} replaces the visa's own [{spouse:f5},{parent:f5}]. Simulating a 16-year-old (spouse: none, parent: f5) shows F-2-3, F-3, F-2-2 and F-6-1 all blocked, so no family route is left. verdicts.reason: F-2-T1 has zero in-edges, so F-2-T1 and F-5-T1 are unreachable. The manual section the repo cites covers visa issuance for the Top-Tier resident's spouse and minor children, and the 2026 announcement says the family also receives F-2. So NONE -> F-2-T1 is right, and its existing needs already gate it. The second half of the fix is wrong. An F-2-T holder is the principal, not a family member, so an F-2-T -> F-2-T1 edge is meaningless. F-2-T1 also has no 'change' document list in visadocs, so an in-Korea edge should not be added until that list exists.
verdicts.correctedFix: data/visamap.yaml, visas: NONE.next: add `- F-2-T1` (next to `- F-2-T`). Do NOT add F-2-T1 to F-2-T.next. If an in-Korea route is wanted later (e.g. F-3 -> F-2-T1), first record the manual's 체류자격 변경 list for F-2-T1 under `change` in data/visadocs.yaml.

verdicts.reason: F-6 나목 has no 'marriage ended' condition and includes de facto relationships, so the how text 'After the marriage to a Korean citizen ended' is wrong for never-married parents.
